title: Book Three · Chapter 47: The Bun on the Plate
story:
Leo reaches the green door a little after four.

Mr Qiu looks up from his stall.

“You grew,” he says.

“So did the boxes.”

There are three beside the stall today. Mr Qiu taps the nearest one.

“These can shrink very quickly.”

Leo laughs and goes into the yard. Ronan is waiting near the blue bike.

Leo touches the old bell.

“Still this one.”

“Still works.”

He rings it once. Mum looks out of the window.

“I can hear that.”

Leo lifts a hand. She puts her work aside and comes to the door.

After she asks about the journey, she leaves the boys room at the table. Ronan takes his birthday book from the shelf.

Leo notices Mum's green and grey bag on her chair.

“New?” he asks.

“She made it for herself,” Ronan says.

Mum smiles and moves it away from Leo's dusty bag.

The class photo is inside his birthday book. Ronan lays it between them.

“Kai,” he says, with one finger near the back row. “And Anna.”

Leo looks closely at both faces. Then he looks at Ronan.

“You look serious.”

“I was trying not to laugh.”

“It didn't help.”

Ronan laughs now. He shows Leo Anna's card too. The crooked door makes Leo reach for an imaginary pencil.

“A roof,” he says.

“Leave this one alone.”

“All right.”

Leo puts his hands flat on the table. Ronan returns the photo to the book and puts the card away separately.

Then he brings a small bun on a plate. Mum bought it with the bread this morning.

“At last,” Leo says.

Ronan takes the kitchen knife. Mum is beside the table with vegetables, and he leaves her room.

He cuts the bun into two pieces. One is a little larger.

“You choose.”

Leo studies the plate. He moves the larger piece toward himself.

“A year of waiting.”

“Not a whole year.”

“My stomach counted it.”

They eat slowly. Then Leo talks about his aunt's house. The red box is still outside the shop. A new baby next door cries early in the morning.

“Earlier than your alarm?” Ronan asks.

“The baby is my alarm.”

Dad comes home while they are talking. He leaves his work bag and greets Leo with a hand on his shoulder.

At dinner, Leo asks Dad about Mr Sun's place. Dad answers, then asks about the new school. Leo tells him about the bus and the boy with the bad throws.

Mum laughs at that part. She gives the boys more vegetables.

After the meal, Leo checks the time. His aunt wants him at his grandmother's before nine.

Ronan walks with him to the corner. Tomorrow morning, they will meet Kai at the park.

At the turn, Leo lifts one hand.

“The other half was good.”

“You had the bigger half.”

Leo grins. “Still good.”
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

shrink＝缩小、减少；imaginary＝想象中的；separately＝分开放；alarm＝闹钟。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan让Leo看了什么？唯一一张合影最后是否送给了Leo？
2. 旧信里“下次由Ronan切面包”的玩笑有没有兑现？Leo为什么晚上不能一直待着？

## 读句子

**He cuts the bun into two pieces.**

拆开看：He / cuts the bun / into two pieces.

他／把小面包切开／切成两块。
